note: Status board for the Strain Finder's 'next market' panel. Hand-edited; statuses are: live | in-progress | checking | planned | not-feasible. No vote counts on purpose — counts invite duplicate voting and favour cities whose menus publish no terpene panel.

markets.name: Naples area (Bonita Springs & Marco Island), Florida
markets.note: RISE and AYR Bonita Springs publish full lab panels — first pull under way. Naples and Collier County ban dispensaries, so the stores are in Bonita Springs. Medical-only.

feasibility: We can add a market when its dispensaries publish product-level terpene panels (myrcene, limonene, caryophyllene…) on their online menus. Chains that show only total terpenes or a top-3 list can't be ranked yet.
